title: Viva Insights: Access Management for Copilot Analytics roles and permissions
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned Copilot Analytics migration from the documented Agent 365 preview and today's access controls. The actionable paths and commands are supported; minor corrections concern citation coverage, a shortened partition path, and conflicting background licensing guidance.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet document the new Copilot Analytics Access Management UI or automation.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Analytics access policies PowerShell Graph; Copilot Analytics Access Management default licensing prerequisites VFAM migration. Opened introduction, dashboard settings, identification and Business Analytics manage/access; only the latter documents the new UI.

claims.claim: The new Copilot Analytics control's default enforcement state is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Analytics Access Management default enforcement licensing prerequisites migration. Read roadmap, Copilot Analytics introduction, dashboard settings and Business Analytics access; no new Copilot Analytics control enforcement default is stated.

claims.claim: Agent 365 Business Analytics Access management is a Frontier preview feature.
claims.quote: This feature is part of the Frontier preview program.

claims.claim: Business Analytics access uses permission sets, partitions and access policies.
claims.quote: Access in Business Analytics is built from three components: permission sets, partitions, and access policies.

claims.claim: Every Business Analytics tenant starts with Chief Officer, Group Manager and Analyst permission sets.
claims.quote: Every tenant starts with the following system-defined items. They're labeled System-defined in the app and can't be deleted. ... Three permission sets: Chief Officer, Group Manager, and Analyst.

claims.claim: Business Analytics starts with three corresponding system-defined access policies paired with Global.
claims.quote: Three access policies: Chief Officer, Group Manager, and Analyst. Each system-defined policy pairs the permission set of the same name with the Global partition.

claims.claim: The Business Analytics Global partition is read-only.
claims.quote: The Global partition is read-only and can't be deleted.

claims.claim: A Business Analytics user's effective access combines all valid assignments.
claims.quote: the user's effective access is the combination of all of their valid assignments.

claims.claim: Business Analytics permission sets can include identification.
claims.quote: Identification | Whether users can view identifiable data, such as individual names, where your policies allow it.

claims.claim: Business Analytics permission sets can include export.
claims.quote: Export | Whether users can export data from the app

claims.claim: Current Copilot Analytics identification policies are managed by Global or AI Administrators.

claims.quote: Attributes analysts can use to build queries and rules. Each attribute is one column of your organizational data file.

claims.claim: Global Administrators automatically inherit Insights Administrator privileges.
claims.quote: Users with the Microsoft 365 Global Administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID automatically inherit Insights Administrator privileges.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published whether Viva Insights administrators can grant identification or export in the new Copilot Analytics experience.

Opened identification-copilot-analytics and Business Analytics manage/access; one gives today's Global/AI roles and the other governs a different preview app.

claims.claim: The described feature is administrative access management rather than an agent acting on data.
claims.quote: Admins create access policies that combine a permission set, which defines what users can do, with a partition, which defines the population and datasets users can see.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/setup-maint/environment-requirements. This is conflicting background guidance, not a published Access Management licence.

claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchange/add-vivamodulefeaturepolicy to sources: its syntax verifies the command and each printed parameter for this call and controls[2].api. Keep both calls unchanged.

claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name UsersAndGroups -IsFeatureEnabled $false ... If you want to disable the feature for all users, use the -Everyone parameter instead.

claims.quote: Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy. ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off
